"""Shared macros and rules."""

load("@rules_python//python:defs.bzl", "PyInfo", "py_test")

def storefront_py_test(name, **kwargs):
    """py_test with the repo's defaults (small unless told otherwise)."""
    kwargs.setdefault("size", "small")
    py_test(name = name, **kwargs)

def _py_bundle_impl(ctx):
    sources = ctx.attr.dep[PyInfo].transitive_sources.to_list()
    paths = sorted([f.short_path for f in sources])

    manifest = ctx.actions.declare_file(ctx.label.name + ".txt")
    ctx.actions.write(manifest, "".join([p + "\n" for p in paths]))

    return [DefaultInfo(files = depset([manifest]))]

py_bundle = rule(
    implementation = _py_bundle_impl,
    attrs = {
        "dep": attr.label(
            providers = [PyInfo],
            doc = "py_library/py_binary whose transitive Python sources are listed.",
        ),
    },
    doc = "Writes a manifest listing every transitive Python source file of `dep`, one path per line.",
)

def py_bundle_stamped(name, dep, **kwargs):
    """py_bundle whose manifest is stamped with a sha256 checksum header.

    Runs tools/stamp.py over the raw py_bundle manifest to prepend a
    "# checksum: <sha256>" header line.
    """
    manifest_name = name + "_manifest"
    py_bundle(name = manifest_name, dep = dep)

    native.genrule(
        name = name,
        srcs = [":" + manifest_name],
        outs = [name + ".txt"],
        tools = ["//tools:stamp"],
        cmd = "$(location //tools:stamp) $(location :%s) $@" % manifest_name,
        **kwargs
    )

"""Adds a checksum header line to a py_bundle manifest."""

import hashlib
import sys


def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:
    if len(argv) != 3:
        print("usage: stamp.py <input manifest> <output manifest>", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    src, dst = argv[1], argv[2]
    with open(src, "rb") as f:
        content = f.read()

    checksum = hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()
    with open(dst, "wb") as f:
        f.write(f"# checksum: {checksum}\n".encode("utf-8"))
        f.write(content)

    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv))

class ProjectsController < ApplicationController
  def index
    scope = current_user.projects
    scope = scope.where("name LIKE ?", "%#{params[:q]}%") if params[:q].present?
    render json: scope.order(sort_order)
  end

  def show
    render json: project
  rescue ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound
    head :not_found
  end

  def create
    project = current_user.projects.build(project_params)
    if project.save
      render json: project, status: :created
    else
      render json: { errors: project.errors.full_messages }, status: :unprocessable_content
    end
  end

  def update
    if project.update(project_params)
      render json: project
    else
      render json: { errors: project.errors.full_messages }, status: :unprocessable_content
    end
  rescue ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound
    head :not_found
  end

  def destroy
    project.destroy
    head :no_content
  rescue ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound
    head :not_found
  end

  private

  def project
    @project ||= current_user.projects.find(params[:id])
  end

  def project_params
    params.require(:project).permit(:name, :description, :status, :featured)
  end

  def sort_order
    column = params[:sort].to_s
    Project.column_names.include?(column) ? column : { created_at: :desc }
  end
end

RSpec.describe ProjectsController do
  let(:user) { User.create!(email: "ada@example.com", name: "Ada") }
  let(:other_user) { User.create!(email: "grace@example.com", name: "Grace") }

  def controller_for(user, params: {})
    described_class.new(params: params, current_user: user)
  end

  describe "#index" do
    it "returns only the current user's projects" do
      mine = Project.create!(user: user, name: "Mine")
      Project.create!(user: other_user, name: "Theirs")

      controller = controller_for(user)
      controller.index

      expect(controller.response[:status]).to eq(200)
      expect(controller.response[:json].map(&:id)).to eq([mine.id])
    end

    it "orders newest first by default" do
      older = Project.create!(user: user, name: "Older", created_at: 2.days.ago)
      newer = Project.create!(user: user, name: "Newer", created_at: 1.day.ago)

      controller = controller_for(user)
      controller.index

      expect(controller.response[:json].map(&:id)).to eq([newer.id, older.id])
    end

    it "searches by name when q is given" do
      Project.create!(user: user, name: "Website Redesign")
      landing = Project.create!(user: user, name: "Landing Page")

      controller = controller_for(user, params: { q: "landing" })
      controller.index

      expect(controller.response[:json].map(&:id)).to eq([landing.id])
    end

    it "sorts by any given column" do
      b = Project.create!(user: user, name: "B")
      a = Project.create!(user: user, name: "A")

      controller = controller_for(user, params: { sort: "name" })
      controller.index

      expect(controller.response[:json].map(&:id)).to eq([a.id, b.id])
    end

    it "ignores an unknown sort column" do
      Project.create!(user: user, name: "A")

      controller = controller_for(user, params: { sort: "nope; drop table users" })

      expect { controller.index }.not_to raise_error
      expect(controller.response[:status]).to eq(200)
    end
  end

  describe "#show" do
    it "returns the project" do
      project = Project.create!(user: user, name: "Mine")

      controller = controller_for(user, params: { id: project.id })
      controller.show

      expect(controller.response[:status]).to eq(200)
      expect(controller.response[:json].id).to eq(project.id)
    end

    it "returns 404 for another user's project" do
      project = Project.create!(user: other_user, name: "Theirs")

      controller = controller_for(user, params: { id: project.id })
      controller.show

      expect(controller.response[:status]).to eq(404)
    end
  end

  describe "#create" do
    it "creates a project owned by the current user" do
      controller = controller_for(user, params: { project: { name: "New Project", description: "desc" } })
      controller.create

      expect(controller.response[:status]).to eq(201)
      expect(controller.response[:json]).to be_persisted
      expect(controller.response[:json].user).to eq(user)
    end

    it "ignores unpermitted attributes like user_id" do
      controller = controller_for(
        user,
        params: { project: { name: "New Project", user_id: other_user.id } }
      )
      controller.create

      expect(controller.response[:json].user).to eq(user)
    end

    it "returns errors when invalid" do
      controller = controller_for(user, params: { project: { name: "" } })
      controller.create

      expect(controller.response[:status]).to eq(422)
      expect(controller.response[:json][:errors]).to include("Name can't be blank")
    end
  end

  describe "#update" do
    it "updates the project" do
      project = Project.create!(user: user, name: "Old Name")

      controller = controller_for(user, params: { id: project.id, project: { name: "New Name" } })
      controller.update

      expect(controller.response[:status]).to eq(200)
      expect(project.reload.name).to eq("New Name")
    end

    it "returns 404 for another user's project" do
      project = Project.create!(user: other_user, name: "Theirs")

      controller = controller_for(user, params: { id: project.id, project: { name: "Hijacked" } })
      controller.update

      expect(controller.response[:status]).to eq(404)
    end

    it "returns errors when invalid" do
      project = Project.create!(user: user, name: "Old Name")

      controller = controller_for(user, params: { id: project.id, project: { name: "" } })
      controller.update

      expect(controller.response[:status]).to eq(422)
    end
  end

  describe "#destroy" do
    it "deletes the project" do
      project = Project.create!(user: user, name: "Mine")

      controller = controller_for(user, params: { id: project.id })
      controller.destroy

      expect(controller.response[:status]).to eq(204)
      expect(Project.exists?(project.id)).to be(false)
    end

    it "returns 404 for another user's project" do
      project = Project.create!(user: other_user, name: "Theirs")

      controller = controller_for(user, params: { id: project.id })
      controller.destroy

      expect(controller.response[:status]).to eq(404)
      expect(Project.exists?(project.id)).to be(true)
    end
  end
end

import asyncio
from decimal import Decimal

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.auth import get_current_user
from app.clients.payments import PaymentsClient
from app.db import get_db
from app.models import Order, User
from app.notifications import send_email

router = APIRouter(prefix="/orders", tags=["orders"])


def get_payments_client() -> PaymentsClient:
    return PaymentsClient()


class OrderItemOut(BaseModel):
    id: int
    product_id: int
    quantity: int

    model_config = {"from_attributes": True}


class OrderOut(BaseModel):
    id: int
    status: str
    total: Decimal
    payment_id: str | None
    items: list[OrderItemOut]

    model_config = {"from_attributes": True}


class RefundOut(BaseModel):
    order_id: int
    status: str
    refund_id: str
    refund_status: str


def _get_owned_order(order_id: int, user: User, db: Session) -> Order:
    order = db.get(Order, order_id)
    if order is None or order.user_id != user.id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="order not found")
    return order


@router.get("/{order_id}", response_model=OrderOut)
async def get_order(
    order_id: int,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
) -> Order:
    return _get_owned_order(order_id, user, db)


@router.post("/{order_id}/refund", response_model=RefundOut)
async def refund_order(
    order_id: int,
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    payments: PaymentsClient = Depends(get_payments_client),
) -> RefundOut:
    order = _get_owned_order(order_id, user, db)

    if order.status == "refunded":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="order already refunded")

    if not order.payment_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="order has no associated payment")

    refund = await asyncio.to_thread(payments.refund, order.payment_id, float(order.total))

    order.status = "refunded"
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(order)

    await asyncio.to_thread(
        send_email,
        user.email,
        "Your refund receipt",
        f"Order #{order.id} for {order.total} has been refunded. Refund ID: {refund.id}.",
    )

    return RefundOut(order_id=order.id, status=order.status, refund_id=refund.id, refund_status=refund.status)

import os

os.environ.setdefault("DATABASE_URL", "sqlite:///:memory:")
os.environ.setdefault("PAYMENTS_API_KEY", "test-key")

import pytest
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from sqlalchemy.pool import StaticPool

from app.db import Base, get_db
from app.main import app

# The app's own engine uses SingletonThreadPool for sqlite ":memory:", which
# hands out a fresh (empty) connection to the worker thread FastAPI runs
# request handlers on. Tests need a single shared connection instead, so we
# build a dedicated test engine/session and override `get_db` with it.
test_engine = create_engine(
    "sqlite:///:memory:",
    connect_args={"check_same_thread": False},
    poolclass=StaticPool,
)
TestingSessionLocal = sessionmaker(bind=test_engine, autoflush=False, expire_on_commit=False)


def _override_get_db():
    db = TestingSessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()


app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = _override_get_db


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def _reset_db():
    Base.metadata.create_all(test_engine)
    yield
    Base.metadata.drop_all(test_engine)

def test_get_order_returns_order_with_items(client, user, order, product):
    resp = client.get(f"/orders/{order.id}", headers={"X-User-Id": str(user.id)})

    assert resp.status_code == 200
    body = resp.json()
    assert body["id"] == order.id
    assert body["status"] == "paid"
    assert len(body["items"]) == 1
    assert body["items"][0]["product_id"] == product.id
    assert body["items"][0]["quantity"] == 2


def test_get_order_404_when_missing(client, user):
    resp = client.get("/orders/9999", headers={"X-User-Id": str(user.id)})

    assert resp.status_code == 404


def test_get_order_404_when_not_owned(client, other_user, order):
    resp = client.get(f"/orders/{order.id}", headers={"X-User-Id": str(other_user.id)})

    assert resp.status_code == 404


def test_refund_order_success(client, user, order, fake_payments, monkeypatch):
    sent = {}

    def fake_send_email(to: str, subject: str, body: str) -> None:
        sent["to"] = to
        sent["subject"] = subject
        sent["body"] = body

    monkeypatch.setattr("app.routes.orders.send_email", fake_send_email)

    resp = client.post(f"/orders/{order.id}/refund", headers={"X-User-Id": str(user.id)})

    assert resp.status_code == 200
    body = resp.json()
    assert body["status"] == "refunded"
    assert body["refund_id"] == "re_123"
    assert fake_payments.calls == [("pay_123", 25.0)]
    assert sent["to"] == user.email
    assert "refund" in sent["subject"].lower()

    follow_up = client.get(f"/orders/{order.id}", headers={"X-User-Id": str(user.id)})
    assert follow_up.json()["status"] == "refunded"


def test_refund_already_refunded_returns_409(client, user, order, fake_payments, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr("app.routes.orders.send_email", lambda *a, **k: None)

    first = client.post(f"/orders/{order.id}/refund", headers={"X-User-Id": str(user.id)})
    assert first.status_code == 200

    second = client.post(f"/orders/{order.id}/refund", headers={"X-User-Id": str(user.id)})
    assert second.status_code == 409

    # only one refund should have been issued against the payments provider
    assert len(fake_payments.calls) == 1


def test_refund_404_when_not_owned(client, other_user, order, fake_payments):
    resp = client.post(f"/orders/{order.id}/refund", headers={"X-User-Id": str(other_user.id)})

    assert resp.status_code == 404
    assert fake_payments.calls == []


def test_refund_requires_user_header(client, order):
    resp = client.post(f"/orders/{order.id}/refund")

    assert resp.status_code == 422
